title: Community Posts, Polls and Quizzes for Students | AllCoaching
description: Post updates, notes, shorts, polls and quizzes to your students' feed in your own app, and see who follows your academy.
keywords: student community app, poll and quiz for students, coaching app community, engage students online, announcements in coaching app
lede: Community is your app's own feed. Post an update, a page of notes, a short video, a poll, a quiz or a new lecture, and your students see it in your app. Choose who sees each post, and keep drafts for later.
notes: Six post types, from text to quizzes
card: Updates, notes, shorts, polls and quizzes in your students' app feed.

sections.body: Write a text update, such as tomorrow's revision time. Share an image or a page of notes, and your handle is watermarked on it on its own. Add a short vertical video of up to 60 seconds, or announce a new lecture so a preview card reaches your students' feed.
bullets: Text: any update or class plan
Image or notes: JPG or PNG, watermarked with your handle
Short: a 9:16 clip up to 60 seconds, from your library or a new upload
New lecture: pick from your library and post a preview card
sections.alt: Community composer with the Image or Notes post type, a text update and an image upload area

sections.body: Ask a question straight to your students, such as which topic to revise first. They vote, and you know what the class needs before you plan the next session.
bullets: Add as many options as you need
Post now, or save it as a draft
Filter posts by Published, Scheduled, Drafts and Pinned, or by type
sections.alt: Community poll asking students which topic to revise first, with two options

sections.body: Post a quick question with options and tick the correct answer. After students vote, they see the right answer and your explanation, which keeps practice going outside class.
bullets: Mark the correct option with a tap
Add an explanation students see after voting
Followers list shows when each person joined, courses taken and amount spent
sections.alt: Community quiz with a percentage question, the correct option ticked and a worked explanation

steps.d: Go to Community in the studio to see your posts and followers.
Choose text, image or notes, short, poll, quiz or new lecture.
Pick who should see the post.
Press Post to publish now, or Save draft for later.

faq.q: How do I engage online students?
faq.a: Post text, notes, shorts, polls and quizzes in Community; students see them in your app feed.

faq.q: How do I make polls and quizzes for students?
faq.a: Create a new post in Community and pick Poll or Quiz. For a quiz, tick the correct answer and add an explanation students see after voting.

faq.q: How do I post announcements in my app?
faq.a: Post it in Community; it reaches the feed of all your followers.

faq.q: Are my notes protected when I share them?
faq.a: Images and notes you post are watermarked with your handle on their own.
